# Kwiksave Logistics Inc.

Kwiksave Logistics Inc. is a Truck Transportation company. Kwiksave Logistics is Canada's best third-party logistics provider. They offer a range of services including courier, trucking, e-commerce, warehouse, new flagship distribution center, fulfillment, technology, and applications. With over three decades of experience, they have built a reputation as a trustworthy logistics partner, fully committed to their clients' success. Kwiksave Logistics Inc. employs 20 people (+17.6% YoY, +3 people) and has an annual revenue of $18.4M, founded in 1991. Headquartered in Burlington, Ontario, Canada, with presence in United States.

## About

Established in 1991, Kwiksave Logistics has grown over the years as a courier, trucking, warehousing and fulfillment service.
